# SCI-NOI v0.1 r0.5 Target-Law and Member-Selection Disposition

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson. Date: 2026-08-30. Status: proposed scientific-
owner freeze candidate; not frozen.

For every member `b`, let `R_b` be the conjunction of binding completion and
UNC-member-admission facts. Base v0.1 retains its unconditioned ideal
`Uniform(A)` target only when, for every `e in A`,

`P(R_b=1 | epsilon_b=e, fixed parent and plan)=P(R_b=1 | fixed parent and plan)`.

An equivalent deterministic rule is permitted: every binding predicate is
fixed before assignment or returns the same result for every assignment/member
output. Output amplitude, sign pattern, source imprint, map morphology, tail
value, and assignment-dependent QC may be advisory but cannot exclude a member.

Assignment-dependent execution or numerical failure makes the exact base
method unavailable. A failed design cannot be regenerated under the same method
identity until a favorable all-pass result appears. If an assignment-dependent
gate is scientifically required, it creates a different method with a target
law conditioned on selection and correspondingly changed estimator, weights,
uncertainty, and claim. The unconditioned target cannot be retained.

D-015, EQ-017, ASM-006/011, REQ-024/034/035/048, and PRED-023 carry this owner-
preferred base-v0.1 disposition.
